text: Alison Bechdel's Fun Home was challenged in January 2019, when district administrators ordered it removed from library shelves, bypassing board-approved selection and reconsideration policies. Administrators at both high schools in North Hunterdon-Voorhees School District in New Jersey restricted student access to the book. Some students at Duke University in Durham, North Carolina, challenged it as recommended reading for incoming freshmen, objecting to its depictions of lesbian sexuality as borderline pornographic.
